_about: OVERRIDES: OTHER BLOCKS WHERE THE STREAM IS A CERTAIN WAY.
An override is a sticker on its ring. 'when' lists stream properties; all of them must hold. Values run 0 to 1:
slope 0 flat .. 1 sheer (0.05 gentle, 0.2 brisk, 0.5 steep). width 0 = a 1-block brook .. 1 = a 32-block river.
speed 0 still .. 1 the fastest. bend 0 straight .. 1 a hairpin (0.2 = a clear curve). side: inner or outer of a bend.
to_mouth and to_junction: 0 at the sea or lake, or at a confluence; 1 = 16 stream widths away or more.
flat_run: 0 just below a steep part .. 1 a long, settled flat.
Comparisons: > 0.3, >= 0.3, < 0.3, <= 0.3. fade: how softly the sticker comes in. At the threshold it takes
half the blocks, and all of them 'fade' past it (default 0.1).
The mod tries the overrides top to bottom; the first one that succeeds paints. Put the most specific first.
An override can set its own pattern and scale. If it does not, it uses the ring's.
